about.heading: About Us
about.text:
Solar Bright Power Solutions is a leading solar EPC company based in Odisha, committed to delivering clean, affordable, and sustainable solar energy solutions. We provide end-to-end solar services — design, supply, installation, and maintenance — for residential, commercial, industrial, and agricultural applications.

Our mission is to make renewable energy accessible to all by ensuring quality, innovation, and reliability. We are an OREDA-registered and MNRE-compliant organization under the PM Surya Ghar Yojana, offering government subsidy support and professional installation.
